attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording of the Analyst and Investors call dated November 16, 2026.
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited has made available the audio recording of the earnings call discussing unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This submission follows intimation dated November 11, 2026, and November 15, 2026. The recording is accessible on the company website at www.ssmobile.com under the Investor Relations tab. A direct link is also provided at ssmobile.com aboutus investor corporate governance notices and disclosures.php. The company requests the exchange to take this information on record.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the financial results as on September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the newspaper advertisement of un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express Mumbai Edition and Punyanagari Kolhapur Edition on November 15, 2026. The submission is also available on the company website at www.ssmobile.com under the Investor Relations tab.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with respect to an earnings call scheduled for November 16, 2026. The company reported 574 stores across 228 cities in five states as of September 30, 2026. Revenue CAGR was 40% from FY24 to FY26, with a PAT CAGR of 49%. FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 5.3%, and ROE was 31%. The company operates 460 flagship stores, 36 Olineo stores, 78 The Mobile Space stores, and 108 Mobile Exchange Wala stores. Approximately 70% of stores are in Tier II and III towns. The presentation is available on the company website at www.ssmobile.com.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited filed a statement of deviations regarding IPO fund utilization for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Audit Committee reviewed the report on November 13, 2026. The company raised Rs. 3600.00 million through its IPO. Funds were raised on September 21, 2026. Shares listed on September 23, 2026. There is no deviation in the use of funds. Rs. 1399.31 million was utilized during the quarter. Rs. 1811.71 million remains unutilized. Rs. 797.54 million was used for general corporate purposes. Rs. 601.77 million was used for repayment of borrowings. Rs. 133.50 million was used for issue expenses. Unutilized proceeds are parked in bank accounts and deposits. The report is available on the company website.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has submitted the Stock Exchange the Monitoring Agency Report for the IPO, for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Initial Public Offer. The IPO size was Rs. 3,600.00 million. During the quarter, Rs. 1,532.80 million was utilized. Rs. 601.77 million was used for working capital requirements to purchase mobile handsets. Rs. 797.54 million was utilized for general corporate purposes. Rs. 133.50 million was spent on issue expenses. No funds were utilized for capital expenditure for new store fit-outs. The unutilized balance stands at Rs. 2,067.19 million. This amount is invested in fixed deposits with HDFC Bank and Axis Bank. The report confirms no deviation from the objects disclosed in the offer document.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Media Release" having unaudited standalone and consolidated financial details as on September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited filed a press release regarding the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR 9,403 Mn for Q2 FY27, an 87% year-on-year increase. Gross margin stood at 12.7%, while EBITDA reached INR 524 Mn, up 99% year-on-year. Profit after tax was INR 280 Mn, reflecting a 160% year-on-year growth. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue was INR 17,293 Mn, with EBITDA at INR 973 Mn and PAT at INR 517 Mn. The company added 38 stores, bringing the total network to 574 stores across five states. A conference call to discuss these results is scheduled for November 16, 2026, at 10:00 AM IST.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results and Limited Review Report for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 8,971.40 million for the quarter and 16,666.34 million for the half year. Standalone profit before tax stood at 357.38 million for the quarter and 673.87 million for the half year. Standalone profit for the period was 275.55 million for the quarter and 514.28 million for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 4.14 for the quarter and 7.76 for the half year. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 11,625.55 million. Total equity was 6,093.40 million. The company's registered office is in Kolhapur. The website is www.ssmobile.com.

attchmntText: SS Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: SS Retail Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for November 16, 2026, at 10.00 A.M. Participants include Chairman and Managing Director Siddharth Shah and Whole Time Director and Chief Financial Officer Sagar Patil. The presentation will be uploaded to the company website at WWW.SSMOBILE.COM prior to the call. The schedule is subject to change due to business exigencies. Any updates will be posted on the company website. The announcement was filed by Company Secretary Kishor Hupare.
